土星也有季节，从地球看到的环倾角会随着公转而改变。: Saturn has seasons; the apparent tilt of its rings from Earth changes along its orbit.
天王星自转轴倾斜约 98°，看起来像侧躺着绕太阳滚动。: Uranus's axis tilts about 98°, making it appear to roll around the Sun on its side.
天王星大气中的甲烷吸收红光，使它呈现蓝绿色。: Methane in Uranus's atmosphere absorbs red light, giving it a blue-green appearance.
天王星属于冰巨星，内部含有较多水、氨和甲烷等物质。: Uranus is an ice giant, with relatively large amounts of water, ammonia, and methane inside.
威廉·赫歇尔于 1781 年发现天王星，最初曾将它当作彗星。: William Herschel discovered Uranus in 1781 and initially thought it was a comet.
天王星有暗淡的行星环，其中一些通过恒星掩星观测被发现。: Uranus has faint rings, some first detected when they occulted a star.
天王星极区会经历长达数十年的连续日照或黑暗。: Uranus's poles can experience decades of continuous sunlight or darkness.
旅行者 2 号于 1986 年飞越天王星，拍摄了行星和卫星。: Voyager 2 flew past Uranus in 1986, imaging the planet and its moons.
天王星磁轴相对自转轴大幅倾斜，而且磁场中心偏离行星中心。: Uranus's magnetic axis is highly tilted to its spin axis, and the field is offset from the planet's center.
天王星主要卫星的名字来自莎士比亚和亚历山大·蒲柏的作品。: Uranus's major moons are named after characters in works by Shakespeare and Alexander Pope.
冰巨星中的“冰”指物质类别，不表示整颗行星是坚硬冰球。: Ice in ice giant refers to classes of material, not an entire planet made of solid ice.
海王星于 1846 年被发现，数学预测帮助天文学家找到它。: Neptune was discovered in 1846 with the help of mathematical predictions.
海王星有极强的高空风，速度能超过地球上的音速。: Neptune's high-altitude winds can exceed the speed of sound on Earth.
旅行者 2 号于 1989 年飞越海王星，是一次重要的近距离探测。: Voyager 2's 1989 Neptune flyby was a landmark close-up exploration.
海王星大气中的甲烷会吸收红光，影响它的可见颜色。: Methane in Neptune's atmosphere absorbs red light, affecting its visible color.
海王星著名的大暗斑是大气风暴，风暴会形成、变化和消失。: Neptune's Great Dark Spot was an atmospheric storm; such storms form, change, and disappear.
海王星有暗淡的环，部分环内物质分布不均匀，形成环弧。: Neptune has faint rings, with unevenly distributed material forming arcs in some of them.
海卫一沿着与海王星自转相反的方向公转。: Triton orbits opposite to Neptune's rotation.
海王星向外释放的能量多于它从太阳吸收的能量。: Neptune emits more energy than it absorbs from the Sun.
海王星在 2011 年完成了自发现以来的第一次绕日公转。: Neptune completed its first orbit since discovery in 2011.
海王星没有能像地球地面一样供人站立的固体外表面。: Neptune has no solid outer surface to stand on like Earth's ground.
冥王星属于矮行星，是柯伊伯带中的重要成员。: Pluto is a dwarf planet and a major member of the Kuiper Belt.
新视野号于 2015 年飞越冥王星，首次带来清晰的近距离影像。: New Horizons flew past Pluto in 2015, returning its first clear close-up images.
冥王星表面的心形明亮区域被称为汤博区。: Pluto's bright heart-shaped region is called Tombaugh Regio.
斯普特尼克平原覆盖着氮冰，表面显示出地质活动的痕迹。: Sputnik Planitia is covered in nitrogen ice and shows signs of geological activity.
在冥王星的低温环境下，水冰可以像岩石一样构成山体。: In Pluto's cold environment, water ice can build mountains like rock.
冥王星稀薄大气以氮为主，还含有甲烷和一氧化碳。: Pluto's thin atmosphere is mainly nitrogen, with methane and carbon monoxide.
冥王星与冥卫一共同绕行的质心位于冥王星之外。: Pluto and Charon orbit a shared center of mass outside Pluto itself.
冥王星与海王星存在 3∶2 轨道共振，有助于避免近距离相遇。: Pluto's 3:2 orbital resonance with Neptune helps prevent close encounters.
冥王星在部分轨道区段比海王星更靠近太阳。: For part of its orbit, Pluto is closer to the Sun than Neptune.
椭圆轨道上的太阳位于一个焦点，而不是椭圆的几何中心。: The Sun lies at a focus of an elliptical orbit, not at its geometric center.
同一条椭圆轨道上，天体靠近太阳时通常运行得更快。: Along a given elliptical orbit, a body generally moves faster near the Sun.
轨道偏心率为零时是圆；偏心率越接近一，椭圆越细长。: An eccentricity of zero is a circle; as it approaches one, the ellipse becomes more elongated.
恒星日以远方恒星为参照；太阳日以太阳再次经过同一子午线为参照。: A sidereal day uses distant stars as a reference; a solar day measures the Sun's return to the same meridian.
天体的自转轴倾斜会改变各纬度收到阳光的方式，是季节形成的重要因素。: Axial tilt changes how sunlight reaches different latitudes and is a key cause of seasons.
我们用肉眼看到的行星亮光，主要来自它们反射的太阳光。: The visible light of planets seen with the naked eye is mainly reflected sunlight.
轨道倾角需要说明参考平面；太阳系行星常用地球轨道平面作为参考。: Orbital inclination needs a reference plane; planetary orbits often use Earth's orbital plane.
一颗天体的质量和半径共同影响表面引力，体积更大不一定引力更强。: Mass and radius together determine surface gravity; a larger body need not have stronger gravity.
太阳系不是静止的平面图，行星还会在轨道参考平面的上下运动。: The Solar System is not a static flat diagram: planets move above and below the reference plane.
望远镜看到的是光离开天体时的状态；越遥远，光传播所需时间通常越长。: A telescope shows a body as it was when its light left; greater distance generally means a longer light-travel time.
太阳是一颗恒星，靠核心中的核聚变释放能量。: The Sun is a star powered by nuclear fusion in its core.
太阳核心把氢聚变成氦，少量质量转化为能量。: The solar core fuses hydrogen into helium, converting a little mass into energy.
太阳约占整个太阳系总质量的 99.8%。: The Sun contains about 99.8% of the Solar System's total mass.
太阳可见表面的温度约为 5,500 摄氏度。: The Sun's visible surface is about 5,500°C.
太阳核心温度约为 1,500 万摄氏度。: The Sun's core is about 15 million°C.
太阳可见的表层叫光球，并不是坚硬的地面。: The visible solar layer is the photosphere, not solid ground.
太阳外层大气叫日冕，温度可达百万摄氏度。: The Sun's outer atmosphere, the corona, can reach millions of degrees Celsius.
日全食期间，明亮光球被遮住，可以看见日冕。: During a total solar eclipse, the bright photosphere is hidden and the corona becomes visible.
太阳黑子是较冷、磁场较强的区域，仍然十分炽热。: Sunspots are cooler, strongly magnetic regions, but remain extremely hot.
太阳活动有大约 11 年的周期，并不是每次都严格等长。: Solar activity follows a roughly 11-year cycle whose length varies.
太阳不是刚体，赤道区域通常比极区自转更快。: The Sun is not rigid; equatorial regions usually rotate faster than polar regions.
太阳风是从太阳向外流动的带电粒子。: The solar wind consists of charged particles flowing outward from the Sun.
太阳耀斑会迅速释放能量，可能影响地球无线电通信。: Solar flares rapidly release energy and can affect radio communication on Earth.
日冕物质抛射会把大量等离子体和磁场送入太空。: Coronal mass ejections send large amounts of plasma and magnetic field into space.
极光来自带电粒子与高层大气相互作用，太阳活动会影响它。: Auroras arise when charged particles interact with the upper atmosphere; solar activity influences them.
光从太阳到地球平均需要约 8 分 20 秒。: Sunlight takes about 8 minutes 20 seconds to reach Earth on average.
太阳的年龄约为 46 亿年。: The Sun is about 4.6 billion years old.
太阳最终会膨胀成红巨星，但这属于数十亿年后的演化。: The Sun will eventually expand into a red giant, billions of years from now.
太阳质量不足以在生命末期发生核心坍缩型超新星爆炸。: The Sun is not massive enough to end its life as a core-collapse supernova.
太阳最终留下的致密核心将成为白矮星。: The Sun's remaining dense core will eventually become a white dwarf.
太阳主要由氢和氦组成。: The Sun is made mainly of hydrogen and helium.
太阳光经过棱镜能展开成光谱，谱线能揭示化学成分。: A prism spreads sunlight into a spectrum; spectral lines reveal its chemical composition.
光球上的米粒状结构与表面附近的对流有关。: Granules on the photosphere are linked to convection near the surface.
太阳也在运动，和太阳系一起绕银河系中心运行。: The Sun moves too, orbiting the Milky Way's center with the Solar System.
太阳绕银河系一周需要约两亿多年。: The Sun takes a little over 200 million years to orbit the Milky Way once.
太阳影响范围远超海王星，太阳风吹出的巨大区域称为日球层。: The Sun's influence extends far beyond Neptune; its solar wind creates the vast heliosphere.
太阳系天体共同绕质心运动，太阳也会因行星引力而轻微摆动。: Solar System bodies orbit their common center of mass; planets make the Sun wobble slightly too.
太阳在太空中看起来接近白色，地球大气会改变我们看到的颜色。: The Sun looks nearly white in space; Earth's atmosphere changes the colors we see.
太阳的引力把八大行星及许多小天体维系在绕日轨道上。: Solar gravity keeps the eight planets and many small bodies in orbits around the Sun.
太阳内部有辐射区与对流区，能量通过不同方式向外传递。: Inside the Sun, radiative and convective zones transport energy outward in different ways.
哈雷彗星是第一颗被确认会周期性回归的彗星。: Halley's Comet was the first comet recognized as returning periodically.
埃德蒙·哈雷比较了多次历史观测，推断它们属于同一颗彗星。: Edmond Halley compared historical sightings and inferred they were the same comet.
哈雷彗星最近一次经过近日点是在 1986 年。: Halley's Comet last passed perihelion in 1986.
哈雷彗星预计在 2061 年再次回到近日点附近。: Halley's Comet is expected to return near perihelion in 2061.
哈雷彗星逆向绕太阳公转，与大多数行星相反。: Halley's Comet orbits retrograde, opposite to most planets.
乔托号在 1986 年近距离拍摄了哈雷彗核。: Giotto photographed Halley's nucleus up close in 1986.
哈雷彗核形状不规则，表面很暗，并不是一颗明亮冰球。: Halley's nucleus is irregular and very dark, not a bright ball of ice.
宝瓶座 η 流星雨与哈雷彗星留下的碎屑有关。: The Eta Aquariid meteor shower comes from debris left by Halley's Comet.
猎户座流星雨也来自哈雷彗星的碎屑流。: The Orionid meteor shower also comes from Halley's debris stream.
哈雷彗星一圈大约需要 76 年，具体周期会受行星引力影响。: Halley's orbital period is roughly 76 years, varying with planetary gravity.
恩克彗星绕太阳一周只需约 3.3 年。: Encke's Comet orbits the Sun in only about 3.3 years.
恩克彗星以计算其周期轨道的约翰·恩克命名。: Encke's Comet is named for Johann Encke, who calculated its periodic orbit.
恩克彗星最早在 1786 年被皮埃尔·梅尚观测到。: Pierre Méchain first observed Encke's Comet in 1786.
恩克把不同年份的彗星观测联系起来，确认它们是同一个天体。: Encke linked observations from different years to confirm they described the same body.
恩克彗星的正式编号为 2P，是很早获得周期彗星编号的成员。: Encke's official designation is 2P, among the earliest numbered periodic comets.
恩克彗核直径约为 4.8 公里，比大行星小得多。: Encke's nucleus is about 4.8 km across, far smaller than a major planet.
恩克彗星与金牛座流星群的碎屑复合体有关。: Encke's Comet is associated with the Taurid meteoroid complex.
恩克彗星近日点在水星轨道以内，轨道远端延伸到火星之外。: Encke's perihelion lies inside Mercury's orbit; its far end reaches beyond Mars.
恩克彗星的轨道偏心率很高，离太阳的距离变化显著。: Encke's highly eccentric orbit causes large changes in its distance from the Sun.
频繁回归意味着恩克彗星反复经历太阳加热与物质流失。: Frequent returns expose Encke repeatedly to solar heating and material loss.
67P 彗星于 1969 年被发现，名称来自两位发现者。: Comet 67P was discovered in 1969 and named after its two discoverers.
67P 彗星的双叶形彗核常被比喻成小鸭子。: 67P's two-lobed nucleus is often compared to a rubber duck.
罗塞塔号于 2014 年抵达 67P，成为首艘绕彗星运行的探测器。: Rosetta reached 67P in 2014 and became the first spacecraft to orbit a comet.
菲莱着陆器在 2014 年首次实现了彗星表面着陆。: Philae made the first landing on a comet's surface in 2014.
菲莱首次接触表面后发生弹跳，最终停在阴影较多的位置。: Philae bounced after first touching the surface and finally settled in a shaded location.
罗塞塔号跟随 67P 经过 2015 年的近日点，观察活动变化。: Rosetta followed 67P through its 2015 perihelion to observe changes in activity.
67P 表面有陡崖、坑洞和覆盖尘埃的区域，地形十分复杂。: 67P has cliffs, pits, and dusty regions, giving it complex terrain.
67P 曾近距离经过木星，木星引力显著改变了它的轨道。: A close encounter with Jupiter significantly changed 67P's orbit.
罗塞塔号在 2016 年以受控下降到彗星表面的方式结束任务。: Rosetta ended its mission in 2016 with a controlled descent to the comet's surface.
彗星喷气会施加微小推力，67P 的自转也会随活动发生变化。: Outgassing exerts small thrusts, so 67P's spin also changes with its activity.
海尔—波普彗星于 1995 年由艾伦·海尔和托马斯·波普独立发现。: Alan Hale and Thomas Bopp independently discovered Hale–Bopp in 1995.
海尔—波普彗星的正式名称是 C/1995 O1。: Hale–Bopp's official designation is C/1995 O1.
海尔—波普彗星在 1997 年经过近日点，成为著名的明亮彗星。: Hale–Bopp passed perihelion in 1997, becoming a celebrated bright comet.
海尔—波普彗星在离太阳仍很远时就展现出明显活动。: Hale–Bopp was already notably active while still far from the Sun.
海尔—波普是一颗长周期彗星，回归需要数千年。: Hale–Bopp is a long-period comet whose return takes thousands of years.
海尔—波普的彗核估计有数十公里宽，明显大于许多熟悉的彗核。: Hale–Bopp's nucleus is estimated to span tens of kilometers, much larger than many familiar comets.
海尔—波普曾同时展现明亮的尘埃尾和较直的离子尾。: Hale–Bopp displayed both a bright dust tail and a straighter ion tail.
海尔—波普的轨道高度倾斜，远离行星主要所在的轨道平面。: Hale–Bopp's highly inclined orbit carries it far from the main planetary orbital plane.
海尔—波普的远日点远远超出海王星轨道。: Hale–Bopp's aphelion lies far beyond Neptune's orbit.
海尔—波普的下一次回归不能只靠把一个固定周期加到 1997 年来精确预报。: Adding a fixed period to 1997 is not enough to predict Hale–Bopp's next return precisely.
彗核是彗星的固体主体，主要由冰、尘埃和岩石物质混合组成。: The nucleus is a comet's solid body, made mainly of ice, dust, and rock mixed together.
彗星靠近太阳时，冰可直接升华成气体，并带出尘埃。: Near the Sun, cometary ice can sublimate directly to gas and carry dust with it.
彗核周围弥散的气体与尘埃包层叫彗发。: The diffuse envelope of gas and dust around the nucleus is the coma.
离子尾受太阳风影响，大致朝向背离太阳的方向。: The solar wind influences the ion tail, directing it roughly away from the Sun.
尘埃尾中的颗粒有各自轨道，因此常常形成弯曲的尾巴。: Dust-tail particles have their own orbits, often producing a curved tail.
彗星远离太阳时也可能让尾巴指向前方；彗尾不是沿运动方向拖出的尾气。: A comet's tail can point ahead as it moves away from the Sun; it is not exhaust trailing its motion.
一颗彗星的彗发可以比彗核大很多倍，照片里的亮团并不等于实体大小。: A coma can be many times larger than its nucleus; a photo's bright cloud is not the solid body's size.
地球穿过彗星留下的碎屑流时，可能出现流星雨。: Meteor showers can occur when Earth crosses debris left by a comet.
流星是小颗粒进入大气后形成的发光现象，并不是恒星掉下来。: A meteor is light produced when a small particle enters the atmosphere, not a falling star.
大多数彗星即使回归，也需要望远镜才能观测。: Most returning comets still require a telescope to observe.
彗星亮度受活动程度影响，不能只用离地球的距离来判断。: Comet brightness depends on activity, not just distance from Earth.
短周期彗星通常指公转周期小于 200 年的彗星。: Short-period comets generally have orbital periods under 200 years.
长周期彗星的许多轨道指向遥远的奥尔特云来源。: Many long-period comet orbits suggest origins in the distant Oort Cloud.
彗星保留着早期太阳系物质，是研究行星形成的样本。: Comets preserve early Solar System material and help us study planetary formation.
彗星在近日点通常运动得更快，在远日点运动得更慢。: Comets generally move faster at perihelion and slower at aphelion.
木星等行星的引力可以改变彗星轨道，有时甚至导致彗核破碎。: Planetary gravity, especially Jupiter's, can change comet orbits and sometimes disrupt their nuclei.
彗星喷出的气体会产生微小反作用力，精确预报需要考虑这种影响。: Cometary gas jets exert small reaction forces that precise predictions must include.
轨道参数对应一个参考时刻；使用越久，忽略的扰动越可能累积。: Orbital elements refer to an epoch; neglected perturbations can accumulate over time.
编号中的 P 表示周期彗星；C 常用于非短周期的彗星。: P in a comet designation means periodic; C is commonly used for comets that are not short-period.
彗核表面常被暗色尘埃覆盖，拥有冰不代表外表雪白。: Dark dust often coats comet nuclei; containing ice does not make their surfaces snow-white.
月球表面的月海是古代熔岩平原，不是液态海洋。: The Moon's maria are ancient lava plains, not liquid seas.
月球引力约为地球表面引力的六分之一。: Lunar surface gravity is about one sixth of Earth's.
月相从一次新月循环到下一次新月约需 29.5 天。: The phase cycle from one new moon to the next takes about 29.5 days.
月球背面也能照到太阳，并不是永远黑暗的一面。: The Moon's far side receives sunlight too; it is not permanently dark.
阿波罗 11 号在 1969 年实现人类首次登月。: Apollo 11 made the first crewed Moon landing in 1969.
火卫一和火卫二由阿萨夫·霍尔在 1877 年发现。: Asaph Hall discovered Phobos and Deimos in 1877.
火卫一比火星自转更快，在火星天空中从西边升起。: Phobos orbits faster than Mars rotates, rising in the west in the Martian sky.
斯蒂克尼撞击坑是火卫一上醒目的巨大地形。: Stickney is an enormous, conspicuous crater on Phobos.
火卫一的形状很不规则，并不是缩小版的圆月球。: Phobos is very irregular in shape, not a miniature round Moon.
火卫一轨道正在缓慢向火星靠近。: Phobos's orbit is slowly drawing closer to Mars.
火卫二比火卫一小，也离火星更远。: Deimos is smaller than Phobos and farther from Mars.
火卫二表面的松散物质掩盖了部分撞击地貌。: Loose material on Deimos partly masks its impact features.
火卫二是形状不规则的小型卫星。: Deimos is a small, irregularly shaped moon.
火卫二约需 30 小时绕火星一周，比火星一天略长。: Deimos orbits Mars in about 30 hours, slightly longer than a Martian day.
木卫一表面丰富的硫及其化合物带来黄、红等颜色。: Sulfur and its compounds give Io's surface yellow, red, and other colors.
木卫一的火山会把物质喷到表面上空很高的位置。: Io's volcanoes eject material high above its surface.
木卫一与木卫二、木卫三存在轨道共振。: Io, Europa, and Ganymede are linked by an orbital resonance.
木卫一比地球的月球稍大。: Io is slightly larger than Earth's Moon.
木卫一是四颗伽利略卫星中最靠近木星的一颗。: Io is the innermost of the four Galilean moons.
木卫二冰面布满交错的线状裂纹。: Europa's icy surface is crisscrossed by linear fractures.
木卫二略小于地球的月球。: Europa is slightly smaller than Earth's Moon.

伽利略卫星包括木卫一、木卫二、木卫三和木卫四。: The Galilean moons are Io, Europa, Ganymede, and Callisto.
明亮的环由无数冰与岩石颗粒组成。土星是一颗低密度的气态巨行星，拥有包括土卫六在内: Its bright rings contain countless ice and rock particles. Saturn is a low-density gas giant with a large moon family, including Titan.
土卫六拥有浓厚大气，表面存在液态甲烷和乙烷的湖泊。: Titan has a thick atmosphere and lakes of liquid methane and ethane.

太阳系公认的五颗矮行星：谷神星、冥王星、妊神星、鸟神星和阋神星。: The five recognized dwarf planets are Ceres, Pluto, Haumea, Makemake, and Eris.
水星、金星、地球、火星。四颗拥有固体表面的类地行星聚集在太阳附近。: Mercury, Venus, Earth, and Mars: four terrestrial planets with solid surfaces clustered near the Sun.

木星、土星是气态巨行星；天王星、海王星是冰巨行星。它们都拥有环和卫星系统。: Jupiter and Saturn are gas giants; Uranus and Neptune are ice giants. All have rings and moon systems.
海王星之外的冰质天体盘，保留着太阳系形成早期的遗迹。冥王星、妊神星和鸟神星都在这: An icy disc beyond Neptune, preserving remnants of the early Solar System. Pluto, Haumea, and Makemake belong here.
受海王星引力散射的冰质天体分布在更偏心、倾斜的轨道上。阋神星属于这一遥远族群。: Icy bodies scattered by Neptune occupy more eccentric and inclined orbits. Eris belongs to this distant population.
太阳风在星际介质中吹出的巨大空间。日球顶标志太阳风主导区的边界，并不是太阳引力的: The vast region inflated by solar wind within the interstellar medium. The heliopause bounds the solar-wind-dominated region, not the Sun's gravity.
